summary.text: You will receive one document from the hospital or doctor who certified the death.

details.heading: Possible documents
details.body: You may receive an NEHR printout, an eRBD printout, or a Confirmation of Death (COD) or Confirmation of Stillbirth (COS).

details.heading: If certified outside hospital
details.body: You may receive a photo of the document instead of a printout.

example_phrasings: What document will I receive from the hospital or doctor who registered the death?
What document will I receive after a death?
What paper does the hospital give me?

sources.page_title: What document will I receive from the hospital or doctor who registered the death?

quotes.text: After a death or stillbirth has been certified, you'll receive 1 document from the hospital or doctor.
National Electronic Health Record (NEHR) printout Electronic Registration of Births and Deaths (eRBD) printout Confirmation of Death (COD) or Confirmation of Stillbirth (COS)
If the death was certified outside of a hospital, you may receive a photo of the document instead of a printout.
If you received a Certificate of Cause of Death (CCOD), please contact ICA at Go.gov.sg or 6391 6100 for assistance.
